steps.instruction: Pay the cheapest flight CO357 fare of 484.05 USD to billing account ACCT-CJX-9203 with memo 'flight booking'. CO357 is cheaper than ME875 (491.81) and SK576 (1339.63).
Pay The Linden 109.41 x 3 nights = 328.23 USD to billing account ACCT-TLX-5470 with memo 'hotel booking'. The Linden is the cheapest hotel (Harbor View Inn 153.92, Atlas Suites 282.00).
Set KV key trip/total to 812.28 (flight 484.05 + hotel 328.23), formatted with 2 decimals.
